blocks.body:
## Decision readout

Reach is still sparse, so the immediate growth constraint is discovery rather than catalog depth. The strongest retention appears in the two CRM architecture stories, but every story has a very small sample. Treat the ranking as a direction for testing—not causal proof.

## Scope and caveats

- **August funnel:** account totals for August 2026.
- **Story table:** lifetime totals per story, not an August subset.
- **Read ratio:** Medium's displayed reads divided by views, preserved at the displayed rounding.
- **Interactions:** all six Medium stories showed zero clappers, highlighters, responders, and reposters at capture time.
- **Decision rule:** do not interpret ranking changes until each story has a materially larger view denominator.

query.sql: SELECT scopes.currentMonth.presentations AS presentations, scopes.currentMonth.views AS views, scopes.currentMonth.reads AS reads FROM read_json_auto('analytics/engagement-baseline.json')
query.description: Read-only capture of the signed-in Medium account summary for August 2026.
metric_definitions: Presentations = Medium's displayed count of story presentations during August 2026.
Views = Medium's displayed count of story views during August 2026.
Reads = Medium's displayed count of reads during August 2026.

query.sql: SELECT scopes.audienceLifetime.followers AS followers, scopes.audienceLifetime.emailSubscribers AS email_subscribers FROM read_json_auto('analytics/engagement-baseline.json')
query.description: Read-only capture of the signed-in Medium audience totals.
metric_definitions: Followers = current lifetime Medium followers at capture time.
Subscribers = current lifetime Medium email subscribers at capture time.

query.sql: SELECT item.story, item.slug, item.presentations, item.views, item.reads, item.readRatio AS read_ratio FROM read_json_auto('analytics/engagement-baseline.json') AS source, UNNEST(source.scopes.storyLifetime) AS rows(item)
query.description: Read-only capture of lifetime presentations, views, reads, and read ratios for the six Medium-published stories.
filters: Stories: published on Medium at capture time
metric_definitions: Read ratio = reads divided by views for a story, preserved at Medium's displayed rounding.
Story presentations, views, and reads are lifetime values and are not reconciled to the August account totals.
